messages:
maria: quick prelaunch check — we need a compact plan for launch conversion paths + SEO tagging + GTM snippets. can we lock this today?

ashley: +1. primary asks? landing page canonical, CTA url tagging, redirect plan for retired pages, schema for webinar, and internal link anchors.

maria: exactly. also want explicit inbound routing for webinar signups -> crm funnel (UTM -> form mapping -> webhook). keep it actionable not ideal.

devin: putting together a short mapping doc. suggested name scheme for CTAs: ?utm_source=launch&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=product_launch_v1&utm_content=cta1

sam: for canonicalization we should force canonical header and meta. example nginx rule I used: 
```
add_header Link "<https://redwood.ai/launch>; rel=canonical" always;
```
will also include <link rel=\"canonical\" href=\"https://redwood.ai/launch\"> in templates.

olivia: redirect plan — prefer 301 for permanent pages, 302 only for experiments. list of old slugs to retire? i'll take inventory.

maria: thanks. inline priorities: 1) landing canonical + meta, 2) CTA UTM mapping + GTM snippet, 3) redirects for top 50 traffic pages, 4) JSON-LD for webinar + FAQ, 5) internal anchor map for product docs -> blog posts.

devin: GTM snippet for conversion event (post-click) — gist: 
```
window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);};
gtag('event', 'launch_cta_click', { 'event_category': 'launch', 'event_label': 'cta-primary' });
```
we should standardize event names to match GA4.

ashley: can we add a quick schema for the webinar page? minimal JSON-LD: 
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-07T17:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
```
We'll expand with speaker names and offers later.

seo-bot: note: run sitemap update job after redirects applied. current sitemap lastmod: 2026-02-12.

sam: internal linking — propose anchor map: blog -> product docs for feature names, e.g. blog post 'low-cost-inference' -> docs 'optimize-batching' and 'quantization-guide'. i'll draft JSON spreadsheet with source/anchor/target.

maria: inbound routing: forms should set hidden fields: utm_campaign, utm_source, utm_content, referrer, page_slug. webhook payload to HubSpot should include lead_source=launch, model_interest checkboxes. who owns forms?

olivia: i'll own form fields + HubSpot mapping. need sample webhook payload.

devin: sample small payload: {"email":"{{email}}","utm_campaign":"{{utm_campaign}}","page":"/launch","lead_source":"launch"} — we can post to /hooks/hubspot-launch.

ashley: redirects — quick example for Netlify/_redirects: 
```
/old-launch  /launch  301!
/blog/old-post  /blog/new-post 301
```
confirm with eng before mass apply.

maria: timeline — olivia for forms + hubspot mapping by EOD, sam anchor map by EOD, devin GTM + event names by noon, ashley canonical/meta and schema draft by EOD. i'll compile into one checklist and ping eng.

olivia: noted, will add acceptance criteria: successful form -> hubspot test contact with UTM fields populated.

sam: will include priority tag for top internal links (high/med/low) and pageview threshold.

devin: small note — for GTM we should also use a dataLayer key `launch_variant` for A/B messaging. helps inbound segmentation.

maria: perfect. final ask: please add one sample redirect file and one schema snippet to the checklist doc so eng has copy-paste. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ashley: uploading checklist now -> https://drive.redwood.ai/launch-seo-checklist (will share after upload).

seo-bot: reminder: schedule crawl after deploy + run Lighthouse mobile perf for landing path.

maria: done, will follow up with a quick standup 11:30.
